title.narrative: Ho Chi Minh City Third Ring Road Technical Assistance Project

description.narrative: The Third Ring Road will be constructed at radius of about 25 km fro the HCMC center. The Tecn Luc-Nhon Trach section in the south of HCMC is financed by ADB under the GMS Ben Luc-Long Thanh Expressway Project. The Tan Van-Binh Chuan section in the north of HCMC is financed by a private sector under the build-transfer arrangement.

Progress/Status: The feasibility and social/safeguards study for the Ben Luc-NH22 and NH22-Binh Chuan sections of RR3 was prepared under the TA Loan. TA Loan closed on 28 June 2018. MOT decided not to prepare detailed designs under the loan since it may adopt PPP procurement for the sections.
